changes: FUNC + PART now opens the Part Edit window in two columns, drawn like the PROJECT menu: PART, LOCKS and other modules' rows on the left, their actions on the right.
Pick LOCKS, press RIGHT or YES, then LOCK SAMPLES or CLEAR LOCKS. LEFT goes back and NO closes, as in PROJECT; the track and confirm screens are as before.
Needs Modwerk base 0.7.9 or newer, over USB.
New: FUNC + PART opens Sample Locks. Lock writes each track's Part sample into the pattern's sample trigs as SAMPLE locks; Clear removes them.
Lock keeps every existing SAMPLE lock unless you turn on Replace existing. Clear removes all SAMPLE locks on the tracks you pick, manual ones too; other locks stay.
Pick Flex and Static tracks, check the per-track counts, then YES applies. Playback keeps going; nothing is saved until you save the project.
Needs the Modwerk base loaded over USB, which is in the beta. Card firmware cannot include it.
Known issue: in one high-load development run, SAMPLE fields on one pattern changed without explanation; the cause is unknown.
